notes.title: Patch 1.2.0: Key Bindings and Leaderboards
notes.content:
Hello peeps!

Update Patch 1.2.0 is live and key bindings are finally here! Besides key rebinding this update introduces leaderboards and more! Below you will find all the changes for this patch:

[h2]UPDATE 1.2.0 PATCH NOTES[/h2]

[h3]Features and Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Keyboard key rebinding is now available![/b]
[*] [b]Added the Crawler Callboard![/b] This interface lets you see a few statistics about your crawlers and your leaderboard rankings. A lot of these values will be zero as they weren't tracked before the Callboard was added but will update as you play
[*] [b]Added Leaderboards[/b] for deepest depths reached and hardcore deepest depths reached
[*] So far only the above leaderboards exist. I plan to add more in future updates
[*] You can view the full leaderboards through the Steam Community page and clicking on "View Stats." Alternatively, you can [url=https://steamcommunity.com/stats/1649130/leaderboards/10804246/]click here to view them[/url]

[*] You can now [b]extract essence from Glyphs at your blacksmith[/b]
[*] [b]Glyphs are now sorted[/b] at your blacksmith from highest to lowest rarity
[*] Glyph roll values have been adjusted so [b]higher tier Glyphs do not roll lower values than lower tiers Glyphs[/b]
[*] Glyph maximum rolls have been [b]buffed by up to 75%[/b] for Ethereal, Astral, Celestial, and Cosmic Glyphs
[*] Glyph drop rates have been lowered across the board due to the value changes.
[*] You were previously guaranteed a Cosmic Glyph when you were above depth 20. Rarity is now randomly rolled depending on depth, with higher tier Glyphs being available at deeper depths
[*] Depth breakpoints for Glyphs have been changed to the following:
[*] [b]Temporal Glyphs[/b] : Depth 1
[*] [b]Ethereal Glyphs[/b] : Depth 5
[*] [b]Astral Glyphs[/b] : Depth 12
[*] [b]Celestial Glyphs[/b] : Depth 25
[*] [b]Cosmic Glyphs[/b] : Depth 40

[*] [b]Added new cards : Sanctity, Divinity, Purity [/b]. These cards heal you and increase your max health
[*] Maximum Health cards no longer heal you if you are at full health. Only the new hybrid cards heal and increase health
[*] Barrels used to get up to hidden chests in a certain room are no longer destructible. You can safely pick Orbital cards without missing out on hidden chests.
[*] Added backgrounds to menus to make them more legible
[*] Added post processing effects when pausing in the Sanctuary to make the pause state clearer
[*] Added [b]volume sliders[/b] to audio settings buttons in main settings menu
[*] Controls panel now only shows the bindings for your current controller type
[*] Welcome message no longer appears if you have already seen it once

[*] Melee attack speed was bugged and enabled you to attack 50 times a second instead of a maximum of 5 times a second. Melee attacks are now capped at 8 attacks per second
[*] Fixed a bug where you could get stuck on the big beer kegs in an overgrown room
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed players to rack up infinite domination runes. If your character has more than 5 dominion points allocated this update will reset your dominions and you will have to reallocate 5 points in your tree.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused hardcore characters to not be reset as intended after perishing
[*] Fixed an issue that caused some XBox One controllers to not be recognized
[*] Fixed a bug at the Blacksmith that did not update the button prompt text
[*] Fixed visual artifacts for smaller fonts when playing in resolutions below 1920x1080
[*] Fixed an issue with the loading screen not consistently fading in and out as intended
[/list] 
[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Buffed all melee damage cards[/b] to help with melee scaling in deeper crawls
[*] Slightly reduced attack speed scaling and buffed base weapon attack speed to balance late game laser beam attack speeds
[*] The following cards have had their values reworked:
[*] [b]Aria of the Druid[/b] - Increased Enhanced defence from 5% to 15%
[*] [b]Composure[/b] - Increased melee damage from 20 to 50
[*] [b]Permanence[/b] - Increased Maximum Health added from 75 to 95
[*] [b]Perseverance[/b] - Increased Enhanced Melee Damage from 10% to 20%
[/list]

notes.title: Update Patch Notes v1.1.1
notes.content:
Hello hello!

Patch 1.1.1 is now live! Below you will find a list of all the changes for the current version.

[h3]UPDATE 1.1.1 PATCH NOTES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reduced the jump cooldown from 1 second to 0.5 seconds
[*] Items can be extracted over the spawner without activating it... for real for real...
[*] Added an icon and text value for domination runes so players know if they have runes to spend
[*] Fixed PS5 and XBox 360 controllers not being recognized
[*] Fixed a bug that caused crawlers to be yeeted out of rooms
[*] If you still manage to be catapulted outside a room somehow, the room will come to your rescue <3
[*] Fixed a bug that caused crawlers to get stuck in walls or through the floor
[*] Fixed a bug that stopped crawler from shooting projectiles
[*] Fixed an issue that caused enemies to take inconsistent amounts of force, making them ping-pong around rooms at neck-break speeds, breaking your neck if you were hit by a goblin fighter jet
[*] Crawler level icon and text moved to the inventory as it was being confused with depth level
[*] Fixed a bug that stopped multiplayer matches from being completed as intended
[*] Fixed a bug that caused enemies to stop moving after being chilled
[*] Fixed Occultist auras freezing enemies in place instead of slowing them down
[*] Reduced the sound effect volume of ignite, chill, and poison effects
[*] Reduced sound effect volume of Trickster passives now
[*] Fixed an issue that caused enemies to drop items twice... sorry...
[*] Reduced the drop chance of cosmetics from Khorgos as it was an easy and reliable way to farm cosmetics
[/list]
Thank you to everyone who has reported bugs and given suggestions, I really appreciate the time and effort taken and thank you to everyone who has played Knight Crawlers!

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0 is Live, and it's a biggy!
notes.content:
Hello peeps,

While working towards patch 1.0.5 I ended up making a lot of changes, bug fixes, and additions to Knight Crawlers and thought this patch deserved to be upgraded to 1.1.0! Below you will find the changelog:

[h2][b]UPDATE 1.1.0 PATCH NOTES[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]General Changes and Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Domination Runes now drop as intended![/b] You can find up to five domination runes scattered throughout the Ancient Realms. 
[*] Creating a new character now works as intended and all progress is properly reset. This will override your save file, but [b]all your cosmetics will be carried over between saves.[/b] I intend to add more save slots in the future so you can have multiple characters.
[*] Game mode selection screen now appears as intended when creating a new character.
[*] [b]Glyphs can now be extracted for essence[/b]. You can't sell them at the Blacksmith yet, but this mechanic will be implemented in v1.1.1.
[*] When going to a new room, [b]all items left on the floor are automatically extracted[/b]. Don't be scared when you are chased by a thousand essences!
[*] The spawner has had a visual overhaul so as to not have it be confused with corpse explosions. The size of the spawner has also been increased.
[*] The shadow the spawner casts has had its opacity reduced so you can see the traps underneath it more clearly.
[*] Fixed a visual issue that made your crawler's arms shake uncontrollably as if he were real cold.
[*] Slightly rebalanced Earthquack to compensate for the insane damage output of the Spell Slingers out there. This only affects people who have specced into tiers 2 and above of the Spell Slinger tree.
[*] Corpse explosions should not be going off and floating in the air.
[*] [b]The depth 100 chest now appears as it always should have.[/b]
[*] Base movement speed has been increased by 20% and base health has been increased from 300 to 400 to make the early game easier.
[*] Critical Strike Chance now updates and displays as intended in your UI.
[*] Defence scaling has been increased to feel more impactful.
[*] Shrine effects are now [b]disabled[/b] if you travel to the Terror's Chamber.
[*] Fixed an issue with Crawler Duties regressing instead of progressing after defeating the First Terror.
[*] Attack speed slightly rebalanced for the end game as it was very easy to fire off 50 projectiles a second.
[*] Projectiles stored in memory during a crawl has now doubled, essentially doubling the projectiles per second you can shoot if heavily investing into attack speed.
[*] Projectiles properly update when picking up a different ranged weapon type instead of only updating after starting a new crawl.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused essences to spawn downwards instead of upwards.
[*] Fixed a bug that stopped Khorgos from attacking.
[*] Added a visual message when looting the Domination Runes and the Ancient Artifact.
[*] Fixed a collider that was awkwardly close to Earthquack that shouldn't have been there.
[/list]
[h3][b]Dominions Rework[/b][/h3]
[b]Conjurer[/b]
[list]
[*] Friendly Imp now gives you [b]3 minions instead of 1.[/b]
[*] Minion damage and attack speed has been [b]significantly buffed.[/b]
[*] [b]Scent of Blood[/b] - Now triggers at 35% health instead of 25%
[/list]
[b]Trickster[/b]
[list]
[*] Dash's distance has been increased to make dodging enemy attacks easier
[*] [b]Intuition[/b] - Now deals more damage when landing on enemies.
[*] [b]Impact[/b] - Dashing now fires [b]35 projectiles instead of 15[/b].
[/list]
[b]Occultist[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Malediction[/b] - Damage has been [b]increased from 50% weapon damage to 125%[/b].
[*] [b]Terrify[/b] - Significantly increased the size of the aura's area of effect.
[*] [b]Intensify[/b] - Now also increases your Occultist aura damage from [b]125% weapon damage to 175%[/b] while also increasing your crawler damage by 25%
[/list]
[b]Spell Slinger[/b]
[list]
[*] Reworked off-hand ranged weapons that can be used with Unstoppable
[*] Once Unstoppable is allocated, off-hand ranged weapons will start dropping
[*] These weapons have very high local damage and attack speed. This is because off-hand weapons are not affected by your main damage, only by ranged damage and weapon type damage.
[*] Off-hand ranged weapons cannot be worn on the main hand and vice-versa
[/list]
[b]Other Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]The Void[/b] - Reworked how the void works. You now get 1 extra damage per enemy killed, but have a 5% chance of increasing the damage you take by 1.
[*] New particle effects have been added for The Void. The higher the amount of extra damage you deal and take, the more intense the effect gets.
[*] [b]Brawler[/b] - Added visual effects for Anger Management and Ravager.
[/list]

Besides the above changes, some polish and small tweaks and bug fixes have been made here and there. Thanks again to everyone who has played Knight Crawlers, for your continued support, feedback, and suggestions.

As most of the major bugs have been addressed, I am excited to start updating Knight Crawlers with new quality of life changes such as key binding, extra save slots, and more content such as the co-op campaign and new realms!

Thank you!
Chaja

notes.title: Update Patch Notes v1.0.4
notes.content:
Hello peeps!

I am slowly but surely going through everyone's reports, feedback, and suggestions and getting updates out as fast as I can. With that being said, patch 1.0.4 is now live and below you will find the changelog.

[b]UPDATE 1.0.4 PATCH NOTES[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Earthquack now drops a Domination Rune as intended[/b]. She now also drops a lot of juicy loot and cosmetics, making farming her a lot more worthwhile. Her damage has also slightly been rebalanced.
[*] Earthquack's Crawler Duty now properly updates to the next step after being defeated.
[*] Earthquack's immunity to active skills is now properly displayed on her health bar.
[*] [b]Attack speed now affects melee attack speed as well.[/b] Thank you to the kind soul who suggested this on Discord!
[*] Base melee attack speed has been increased by 20% to make melee attacks feel better in the early game.
[*] Fixed a bug where your character visuals were not loading properly, leading you to be headless and naked.
[*] General Items (glyphs, cosmetics, domination runes, and artifacts) no longer get looted if you are not actively looking at their tooltip.
[*] Visual effects have now been added for the Dominion passives from the Brawler tree.
[*] Dropped items should stack less frequently making it easier to go through them.
[*] Fixed a bug where if you received health while Celestially Blessed the health bar UI would not visually update as intended.
[*] Fixed a bug where if you died while inspecting a General Item the tooltip would haunt you in your Sanctuary until you found another General Item in a subsequent crawl.
[/list]

Thank you for your patience and continued support through suggestions, feedback, and bug reports, I really appreciate it. I know a big sticking point for many people is key rebinding and I am working hard on getting that implemented as soon as possible.

I am committed to getting as many of these bugs fixed as soon as possible so I can move on to the fun and exciting content updates I have planned for Knight Crawlers!

As always, the best place to report bugs, give feedback or suggestions, or ask general questions is through our [url=https://discord.gg/tm73je8kWn]Discord Server[/url].

Thank you, and I am really appreciative of everyone's feedback and patience.
Chaja

notes.title: Update Patch v1.0.3 Notes
notes.content:
Hello hello,

Patch 1.0.3 is now live! Below you will find a list of all the changes for the current version.

[h2]UPDATE 1.0.3 PATCH NOTES[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added attack indicators to enemies. Enemies now telegraph their attacks and give players time to either dodge or jump out of the way.
[*] Fixed a bug where Dominion minions were not respawning if they were too far from your crawler
[*] Slightly rebalanced enemies and reduced their movement speed to make them easier to handle in the early depths
[*] Fixed an issue where shields could not be equipped
[*] Fixed a glitch that duplicated item stat rolls to items you were currently wearing. Dropped items do not affect the rolls on worn items anymore.
[*] Enemies no longer deal random damage to you and you only take damage when you are hit by a weapon swing, projectile, or if an enemy headbutts you.
[*] Arcane shrines are no longer activated if you are equipped dropped items close to shrines
[*] The spawning circle does not activate if you are extracting items within the spawning area
[*] Wagering Shrine sound effects fixed to better represent whether you received an item or nothing dropped
[*] Wagering Shrine drop rates have been rebalanced to be more rewarding
[*] Arcane Shrine spawn chance has been slightly increased
[*] Glyphs, domination runes, cosmetics, and artifacts are no longer picked up if you are not actively looking at their tooltip
[*] Temporarily removed the lava room as it was causing too many issues with Khorgos and it could potentially brick a crawl if the enemy you were attacking would jump in the lava.
[/list]

Thanks again for all your feedback and bug reports and continued support! If you haven't done so, please join our [url=https://discord.gg/tm73je8kWn]Discord Channel[/url] if you need help with anything or would like to give feedback or suggestions!

Cheers!
Chaja

notes.title: Update Patch v1.0.1 Notes
notes.content:
Hello peeps,

Thank you to everyone who has played the game and given feedback and suggestions, I really appreciate it a whole lot. Given the bugs that were reported, I wanted to update the game to fix some of the most pressing issues. I wasn't able to get all the major bugs, but I will be working through the weekend to release a second patch for those!

[h2]UPDATE 1.0.1 PATCH NOTES[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a visual bug where the crawler duty was incorrectly showing that the Terror's Artifact was in room 35 instead of 45
[*] Removed the lava room that caused Khorgos and other enemies to brick your crawler's auto attacks and stopped you from spawning new enemies
[*] Fixed an issue where changing languages would make text descriptions invisible
[*] Game no longer goes to windowed mode when returning to main menu
[*] Fixed a visual bug that incorrectly displayed the Domination Rune description
[*] Fixed the dreaded freeze time bug where unpausing the game would make the game's time scale 0
[*] Simplified keyboard controls and updated the controls panel for keyboard keybindings
[*] Lowered the SFX volume when defeating Khorgos as it was causing heart attacks all across the nation
[*] Slightly lowered the crawler dialogue volume and his voice lines are now tied to the SFX settings volume
[*] 
[*] Crawler grunt chance has been decreased... ugh...
[*] Fixed a bug where if a player died while a shrine was active the crawler duties were not resetting back to the correct duty
[*] Fixed a bug that would not update the crawler duty tied to spending domination runes
[*] Player no longer gets yeeted into the abyss. This also applies to enemies!
[*] Fixed a bug where corpse explosions were damaging crawlers even if standing outside of the danger zone
[*] Crawler weapons and limbs no longer get stuck in gratings and fences
[*] Removed pesky vines that crawlers could get stuck on in overgrown rooms
[*] Moved the Door Open icon to be centered on the screen to make it more obvious when the door opens
[/list]

Thanks again for all your feedback and bug reports and continued support! If you haven't done so, please join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/tm73je8kWn]Discord Channel[/url] if you need help with anything or would like to give feedback or suggestions!

Cheers!
Chaja

notes.title: Today’s the Day—Knight Crawlers Has Officially Launched!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=0Mf8mWsWlt0;full][/previewyoutube]

Crawlers and Brawlers, it’s time to dive into the realms like never before for the [i]Knight Crawlers[/i] official launch!

We want to give a special thank you to everyone who has played our demo or playtest, joined our discord and provided feedback and suggestions. [i]Knight Crawlers[/i] wouldn't be what it is today without each and every one of you!

Take down hordes of enemies that [i]you[/i] summon as your make your way through dungeons and dark chambers where traps abound. Gather loot, upgrade your skills, and battle your way past powerful mini-bosses as you advance through the treacherous Endless Realms on your way to meet the infamous formidable fowl, Earthquack!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40628295/603e4e0dd57e234a3c65afd0403e27819805d99e.png[/img]

With nearly endless character customization options and potent upgrades you can earn through play, your runs are bound to be unique and exciting each and every time. Strengthen your Crawler with enchantments and Dominions to prepare them to penetrate deeper and deeper into the dungeons ahead and see just how far you can go.

We wanted to let our existing Crawlers know that although we tried our very best, we were sadly unable to save any progress made in the demo, but we hope you see it as an opportunity to start fresh with the new Crawlers!

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40628295/49e282e1fb413a9f899f41e56483fccfea449f4d.png[/img]

[b]PvP[/b] has come to the Realms! See who can take down the most enemies without dying before you turn your weapons on each other for the ultimate Crawler-on-Crawler showdown! Only the mightiest will come out on top!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40628295/2c41ecb1a2193f4b8d681800c6207797f105d380.png[/img]

Don’t have friends? Make some new ones by discovering [b]Companions[/b] as you crawl! That’s right, these cute coconspirators will follow you through the Realms and do their best to help you fight your foes. At least they’ll look adorable trying.

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]

[b]More Realms[/b] to explore are in the works, as well as [b]more Terrors[/b] and [b]miniboss fights![/b] Stay tuned for new dungeons to crawl and new baddies to bring down soon!

Don’t like Crawling alone? [b]Couch Co-Op Mode[/b] is coming! You and your accomplice share health as you work together to take down the hordes and make your way through the Endless Realms together. Are two better than one? Only one way to find out!

Or take a break from teamwork and battle your buddies instead! [b]More PvP Modes[/b]
are on the way and up to four-player arenas will be available so you can fight more friends at once!

[h2]Get Connected![/h2]

We’d like to thank each and every one of you who has played and enjoyed the demo, and we want you to know that [i]Knight Crawlers’[/i] development isn’t stopping here! There are more features on the way that we can’t wait for you to see. If you’re not already, take this opportunity to share your thoughts and be the first to know about impending updates by [url=https://discord.gg/4Q2Yyn5wUZ]joining our Discord[/url] and following us on [url=https://twitter.com/crawlersgame?lang=en]Twitter[/url].

Thank you and we hope to see you smashing goblins soon!

Cheers,
Good Morning Games

notes.title: Knight Crawlers is coming to Next Fest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40628295/13e31b8ddabf8d809523f30c18a79384f4ed301c.png[/img]

[h3]A new and expanded demo of Knight Crawlers will be available to play during Steam’s Next Fest from February 6th-13th at 10am PST.[/h3]

Knight Crawlers is a wobbly physics-based rogue-lite action RPG where you spawn your own enemies, collect potent skill cards, enchant your powerful equipment, and extract the living essence of your foes to upgrade your Crawler.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40628295/751578570d45b3da7a7cf0cb72c09fc4bde4bb5e.png[/img]

With exciting new features available for the first time this week, the expanded demo is full of surprises that’ll keep you on your toes whether this is your first playthrough or your fiftieth. Here are just some of the many updates:

[list]
[*]Several new dungeon rooms to explore
[*]The miniboss—[b]Khargos, The Dread Knight[/b]—has been reworked, including how dominion runes are generated from his successful defeat
[*]Updated button prompts depending on your preferred gaming method (i.e. keyboard, Playstation, or XBox controller)
[*]New and upgraded UI elements, a low health indicator, and a Crawler Duty tracker so you know where the action is
[*]Improved trap effects indicating something dangerous is about to happen
[*]Tons of bug fixes, UI updates, quality of life additions, and streamlining of game elements
[/list]

Enjoy this expanded look into a world where you dodge, damage, and defeat unique enemies as you crawl through the dungeons across the Ancient Realm. Whether your playstyle is a tactical takedown of a few choice combatants or the pure mayhem of battling a room full of warriors all at once, Knight Crawlers provides a unique and heart-pounding experience each playthrough. Just be prepared for a few curveballs along the way.


[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1649130/Knight_Crawlers/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40628295/113880830d0c224de4052f4de1d94279757ed843.png[/img][/url]


Share your best screenshots, coolest builds, funniest flops, and most exciting victories over at our Discord server and be the first to learn about new developments in gameplay!


[url=https://discord.gg/EYSpzrEYEv][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40628295/654a5ba1365616f75cf31fbd37c7f7b4f197269a.png[/img][/url]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40628295/f0b5fbf6d4a75553464d1f6017af689f04ef4ce2.png[/img]

[h2]Full patch notes for version 0.3.15:[/h2]

[list]
[*]There is now a Crawler Duty tracker to give players a sense of direction
[*]Enemies no longer damage you when they are spawned
[*]UI Button prompts now change depending on if you are using keyboard/ps/xbox controllers
[*]The miniboss is now called Khargos, The Dread Knight, and he only drops one domination rune at a time (but in the next update will only drop 1 and the second will be found in a random encounter)
[*]Added boss names to the boss UI frame
[*]Changed the spawn prompt UI to be an icon instead
[*]Removed redundant player messages that weren't legible
[*]Fixed issues with items floating or spawning below the ground
[*]Removed enemy health bar until I have a more elegant solution
[*]Did a balance pass on enemy damage and difficulty scaling
[*]Added a vignette as a low health indicator so the player is aware they are close to death
[*]Fixed a bug where if you left a crawl when the miniboss was alive you couldn't spawn enemies anymore
[*]Streamlined the character creation menu to make it more intuitive and faster for players to get into the game
[*]Created a randomize character button in the creation menu
[*]Added several new rooms to the dungeons
[*]Added effects to certain traps to let players know something dangerous is about to happen
[*]Added a trap sequencer to allow for the creation of trap rooms with sequenced trap events
[*]Game now pauses if a controller is disconnected to avoid unfair deaths
[*]Falling in lava now instantly kills the player
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Patch Notes: v0.3.11
notes.content:
Evening crawlers!
Here is a list of the recent changes made in the Beta Playtest v0.3.11 patch!

[b]Beta Playtest v0.3.11 Patch Notes:[/b]

[list]
[*] The Mama Duck is now ready to fight (name is still being decided on from everyone' suggestions)
[*] Dominions (Class talent trees) have been added to the game
[*] PvP Arenas are now available to play. Active skills are not yet included in PvP due to balance issues but will be added in a future update
[*] Ancient miniboss now lurks in the dungeons. The encounter is randomized every crawl so you never know when you will face the fight
[*] the Scimitar has been removed from the player. This is due to melee weapons being gated behind dominions.
[*] Orbitals have been added : These are card based skills which summon utility orbs that orbit the crawler
[*] A new Sanctuary has been added and defeating Mama Duck will unlock it. In the future you will unlock several different Sanctuaries in a playthrough and you will be able to pick which one you reside in
[*] The enemy slain counter now properly increases when an enemy is slain, and not when it is spawned
[*] Added subtle camera shakes when taking damage to make it more obvious that damage has been taken
[*] Enemy damage from collisions has been refined. This means melee enemies now damage you more consistently. Their damage has been nerfed to reflect this change
[*] Enemy health scaling has been balanced so they are easier to kill in earlier depths
[*] Enemy damage scaling has also been slightly reduced so they deal less damage in earlier depths
[*] Refactored enemy pathfinding to improve performance when a large amount of enemies are spawned
[*] Rebalanced the experience curve to make leveling faster during early levels
[/list]

As I am still actively developing Knight Crawlers, certain features are subject to drastic changes in the future and some that have already been implemented may be tweaked or rebalanced. 

If there is ever anything you would like to see in the game or feel some parts should change, I always welcome feedback and suggestions! You can always join the discord server if you wish to write there. 

[url=https://discord.com/invite/tm73je8kWn]Click here to join the Discord![/url]

Thank you to everyone who has tried the game and for all the feedback and suggestions you have provided <3

notes.title: Beta Update 2
notes.content:
Crawlers!

I finally was able to fix some of the bigger game breaking bugs, mainly not being able to auto-shoot after dying and press the Crawl Again button. I am pushing this update now without addressing every bug and suggestion brought up in the past couple of days because these fixes need to be pushed to you as soon as possible. Thank you for your patience and understanding!

[b]Update 2 Patchnotes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Problem: Dying caused your crawler to stop auto attacking in subsequent crawls.
[b][*] Solution: Found the bug and squashed it. You can now press Crawl Again after dying and attacking will work as intended.[/b]
[*] Problem: Essence values not being saved unless player dies.
[b][*] Solution: Essence is now saved when you walk to the next room, quit the game, or return to sanctuary.[/b]
[*] Problem: Jump cooldown wasn't being applied properly.
[b][*] Solution: Jump cooldown is now 1 second... for real.[/b]
[*] Problem: Corpse explosions from Bombers was way too intense and could potentially ruin a run.
[b][*] Solution: Reduced the amount of force the explosions could deal out.[/b]
[*] Problem: Certain enemy sound effects weren't being muted when sound effects were toggled off.
[b][*] Solution: Fixed enemy audio mixer channels so they are muted accordingly.[/b]
[*] Problem: Player does not need to face enemies when attacking them.
[b][*] Solution: The player now doesn't bother to know where the enemies are, he just annihilates them while staring into the void.[/b]
[*] Problem: It felt unrewarding when extracting essence and not receiving any from low tier items.
[b][*] Solution: Essence is now extracted from all items. Amount has been lowered to compensate for the higher influx of essence in the economy.[/b]
[*] Problem: Pressing dpad down on the controller to spawn enemies makes it difficult to spawn and run.
[b][*] Solution: There is no need to have a dedicated spawn button. Pressing F(keyboard), B(Xbox) or O(PS) now spawns enemies.[/b]
[*] Problem: Some people enjoy moving around with the arrow keys.
[b][*] Solution: Arrow keys can be used for movement, and abilities can be used with Z, X, C, and V keys.[/b]
[/list]
If you haven't already, make sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/tm73je8kWn]Discord[/url] to be kept up to date with development!

Thank you to everyone that has contributed to finding bugs and for all your suggestions, they help me out more than you could ever imagine!


THANK YOU!
